title: Acoustic Classification of Insects
description:
Code, trained models and metadata accompanying the paper Optimizing Spectrogram Front-Ends and Training Strategies for Deep Learning-Based Acoustic Insect Classification (Peter & Kunzelmann, submitted).

The models classify insect sounds (451 species of Orthoptera and Cicadidae) and are trained on InsectSet459 (Faiß & Stowell, 2025).

Contents

  • Code (src/, scripts/, configs/): data download and preparation, training and evaluation (PyTorch, EfficientNetV2-S).
  • Trained models (models/): best_model.pth (64 mel bands, mixup, class-weighted loss) and baseline_model.pth (128 mel bands, no mixup, no class weighting). The checkpoints contain the model weights without the optimizer state.
  • Metadata (metadata/): every InsectSet459 recording used and not used (with split, licence and contributor), a species table with Catalogue of Life, GBIF and ITIS identifiers, the settings of all 112 training runs of the study, and an EML record.
  • Environments: conda_environment.yml and conda_environment_pinned.yml (exact versions, Linux x86-64).

The audio recordings are not included. They can be downloaded from InsectSet459 with the scripts in scripts/; see the README for the full workflow.
